title: Route authorized email submissions into existing Monitoring intake
description:
As an editor, I want publication and explicitly shared Cyclotron submission addresses to ingest safe newsletter links into pending Reference workflows. User authorized implementation on 2026-10-23; this scoped backend slice does not close the broader inbox-reader milestone. Feature: Authorized email reference intake
Scenario: Route a submitted newsletter
Given an explicitly configured publication or shared destination and authenticated allowed sender
When a multipart newsletter with multiple editorial links is received
Then safe links enter existing deduplicated Monitoring and Reference workflows with private provenance
And publication selection precedes section classification
And retries are idempotent and failures visible
And instructions, action links, human labels and automatic publishing are never executed
Scenario: Cloud email without newsletters
Given a cloud-backed site without the newsletter plugin
When its infrastructure is synthesized
Then sender identity and configured email intake are supported independently
And a static-only site requires no email resources
Scope: code, IaC, local fixtures, tests and draft PR only. No deployment, DNS/MX, policy changes, credentials, real email or merges.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Implementation update: remove the editorial link-count cap rather than raising it. Keep technical message bounds (1 MiB MIME, 64 MIME parts, depth 12, 2,048 chars per candidate URL) and normalize/deduplicate every eligible URL inside those bounds. Persist a compact private JSONL sidecar in the existing 30-day raw bucket; receipt metadata records its digest/size, total eligible/excluded counts, byte cursor, processed count and pending status. Drain discoveries in time-budgeted batches with a stable cursor; conditional discovery puts make an interrupted batch safe to replay without overwriting a routed item. Reuse the existing Monitoring routing GSI with an exact monitor-scoped pending key and a small EventBridge resume schedule that invokes the same receiver; keep the existing router schedule/target and sender/MIME checks unchanged. Any additional S3 manifest-write, DynamoDB query and EventBridge invoke grants will be exact resource/prefix/leading-key/source-ARN scoped in the reviewable template, not live-applied here. Final receipt says queued only when every eligible unique link is durable; partial progress remains processing with a checkpoint, hard format/security violations reject visibly, no content is silently truncated. Remove known Beehiiv click-wrapper URLs from downstream discovery and count them as excluded; do not resolve/fetch them until explicit privacy permission. Cross-email canonical Reference reuse remains in existing ReferenceIntake; duplicate deliveries retain independent audit receipts but retries do not duplicate discoveries or recurate References.

Focused tests: all 41 direct links survive in multiple internal batches; more than 1,000 links under the byte bound are not rejected; excluded action/unsubscribe/tracker links; same-email normalization/dedup; mid-batch failure/retry after router advancement; checkpoint resume across schedule invocations; progress and final receipt counts; expired/changed binding fails closed; router cross-email Reference dedup unchanged. No production message, live AWS, security policy, deployment, or tracking URL fetch is part of this change.
